ELEVI Associates

  • Seniority level

  • Employment type

    Full-time

In Order to Join the ELEVI Team you will need:

  • You must have a current or active security clearance with a FS Poly.
  • Possess twenty (20)+ years of experience as a software engineer in programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity is required or 4 more years experience
  • ELEVI requires an experienced developer to deliver a customer facing product to a widespread user base. Must have experience using Jira to create and monitor tickets. This role will have direct customer interaction, including product demonstrations, and daily scrum meetings to convey current status of progress. The ideal candidate will also possess knowledge PULSE / ABACUS, and an understanding of the current modernization efforts to include Report Authoring & Dissemination (RAD).

Required Skills/Experience:

  • Experience with Java, preferably version 21 or greater
  • Experience with Docker, including creating images and keeping them free of vulnerabilities
  • Experience with any modern JavaScript framework, with a preference towards VUE.JS

Desired Skills/Experience:

  • Experience building and publishing Sprint Boot Rest APIs
  • Experience with eVo including integrating with Greybox, Mockito, or other methods of performing low side development that will integrate with high side infrastructure
  • Experience with Bash scripting and other Linux based tools
  • Telework may be available as tasking permits.

Some of the day-to-day activities:

  • Support the modernization of malware analysis and develop techniques for metadata storage for knowledge management to support the defense of national security systems.
  • The engineer will be a part of a team who explores new technologies and prototypes new mission tools and analytics.
  • The team also develops new algorithms and innovative techniques to address mission related problems.
